title: Biome
description: A blazing-fast Rust-powered toolchain for the web that formats and lints JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, and JSON with 97% Prettier compatibility at 25x the speed.
features: Unified linter and code formatter written in Rust
Over 25x faster than ESLint and Prettier in large mono-repos
First-class IDE extensions for VS Code, Cursor, Neovim, and IntelliJ
Single `biome.json` configuration eliminating dozens of plugin packages
Actionable diagnostics with inline code suggestions and auto-fixes
pros: Massive CI build pipeline speedups (runs in fractions of a second)
Replaces ESLint, Prettier, and dozens of plugins with zero config hell
Deterministic formatting with full CST (Concrete Syntax Tree) parser
cons: Ecosystem of community custom rules is still growing compared to ESLint
CSS/Tailwind formatting and linting is currently in active development
targetAudience: Frontend engineers, monorepo architects, and teams frustrated by slow ESLint/Prettier runs.
